requirement_text.REQ-001b: Extract remaining hardcoded copy from all 12 landing components into messages/ru.json and messages/uz.json, wire via next-intl getTranslations/t.rich(). 5 acceptance criteria: (1) every hardcoded Cyrillic string in the 12 components replaced with a translation call, none remaining outside the catalogs; (2) messages/ru.json and messages/uz.json have matching key sets (177 keys each, independently verified); (3) every new uz value non-empty (placeholder duplicate acceptable); (4) npm run build completes with no type/routing errors; (5) /ru and /uz both render all 12 sections with no missing-translation-key errors.

task.description: Run the scope test first per WF-02 Step 3: this requirement has real user-visible surface (rendered copy across 12 sections in 2 locales), continue to the full procedure. Write docs/agents/test-specs/REQ-001b.md: for each of REQ-001b's 5 acceptance criteria, a concrete verification case naming the exact route (/ru, /uz), exact command (curl/grep/node script), and exact expected output. Given the scale (12 components, 177 keys), don't write 177 individual checks — instead write a small number of mechanically precise, comprehensive checks: e.g. one Cyrillic-regex grep across all 12 .tsx files (expect zero matches), one node script diffing ru.json/uz.json key sets (expect 177=177, zero diff), one curl+grep check per locale confirming no next-intl error markers (MISSING_MESSAGE, IntlError) appear in server output, and 2-3 spot-check curl+grep cases confirming specific known strings render correctly on both locales (pick e.g. one from Hero, one from a repeated-shape array component like Team or Events, one from Footer, to span the different extraction patterns used). Also verify the two t.rich() emphasis cases render real <em> tags, not escaped markup.
acceptance_criteria: Every one of REQ-001b's 5 acceptance criteria has at least one verification case that would fail if violated
Each case names the exact command/route and exact expected output, runnable without judgment
